title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent recap without saving a transcript
summary: The briefing passes: its licensing, access restrictions, storage lifecycle and administrative controls are supported by Microsoft's documentation and the supplied records. Two minor qualifications should flag that the PowerShell reference still describes the recap settings as ineffective, whereas the feature article documents their use.

claims.where: Why it matters: organiser account deletion; Open questions
claims.claim: The feature article does not specify what happens to a summary when the organiser's account is deleted.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" "organizer" "deleted" account. Read the feature article in full; its FAQ covers summary deletion, not account deletion. Meeting memory guidance concerns a different artifact.

claims.claim: The feature article does not explain how sharing restrictions, sensitivity labels and DLP apply to these summaries.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" "sensitivity" "DLP" sharing. Read the feature article in full and SharePoint/OneDrive sensitivity-label guidance; the feature article does not describe these controls.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; writer evidence
claims.claim: Sensitivity-label support needs enabling and configuration for OneDrive files.
claims.quote: Enable built-in labeling for supported Office files and PDF files in SharePoint and OneDrive so that users can apply your sensitivity labels in Office for the web.

claims.claim: MC1275312 names the M365 Copilot (Premium) licence.
claims.quote: This feature will be available to users with an M365 Copilot (Premium) license across platforms, including desktop (Windows and Mac), web, and mobile.

claims.claim: The feature guidance documents no separate meter for this experience at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap" "without" "transcripts" "meter" licensing billing. Read the feature article, Copilot meeting prerequisites and recap licensing search excerpts; the feature guidance names licences but no separate meter.

claims.where: Scope; Open questions: Government cloud availability
claims.claim: Government cloud dates are not published for this roadmap item.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" government GCC availability. Read the roadmap record, MC1275312 and feature article; none provides government-cloud dates. Search results about multilingual and ad-hoc recap concern other features.

claims.claim: The expiry control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Copilot and other AI > Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings.
claims.quote: go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Under Copilot and other AI, next to Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings, enter the number of days

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance guidance: At rollout; Governance controls: expiry row
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180 configures summary expiry.
claims.quote:
The following example sets the default expiration time to 180 days.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180
claims.fix: Add this qualification after the controls table: 'The feature article documents -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays for expiry, but the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference still says this feature has not been fully released and the setting will have no effect.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy#-intelligentrecapdocxfileexpirationdays.

claims.claim: Disabling intelligent recap blocks recap in all meetings regardless of saved transcripts while allowing Copilot to remain enabled.
claims.quote:
To prevent users from using this feature while keeping Copilot enabled, turn off intelligent recap in the Teams meeting policy.
Turning off intelligent recap disables intelligent recap for all meetings, regardless of whether transcripts are saved.

claims.claim: The Copilot control is at Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote:
go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -Copilot Enabled configures Copilot for meetings and events.
claims.quote:
To allow users to use Copilot Only during the meeting in meetings and events created by organizers with this policy:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Enabled

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscript is the default Copilot meeting policy value.
claims.quote: On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript | This is the default value.

claims.claim: The Copilot guidance also documents EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn and Disabled as -Copilot values.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled
